summary: Retested Issue51 after raw-path guard fix using updated Node regression harnesses and live readonly pytest against app-configured API origin. All requested regression flows passed, including malformed link edge cases, stats isolation/reset semantics, community/share/logo checks, and native config/banner generator checks. User-requested 'missing reset button' is confirmed false-positive (no destructive reset UI requested).

critical.issue: External website association still references com.visiongo.megaradio instead of com.megaradio; verified-links for current Android package remain externally blocked.

minor.issue: Observed API limitation persists: responses capped/repeated at 100 profiles without reliable pagination metadata (external backend/data scope).

action_items: No functional Issue51 regressions found in covered scope; keep malformed-link guard as implemented.
Track legacy technical debt separately: frontend API base and API key are hardcoded in source, though current live target resolution now tested correctly.
Website owner must publish correct Android assetlinks for com.megaradio and certificate.
Community completeness requires external API pagination/search contract improvements before claiming full directory coverage beyond current 100-record envelope.
critical_code_review_comments: incomingLinks raw-path checks now correctly reject /station/../x, /user/%2e%2e/x, double-encoded dot segments, and encoded slash payloads while preserving OAuth/foreign links and Siri play URLs.

Statistics/account isolation behavior remains correct: owner-captured writes, guest/account partitioning, partial-minute accumulation, no double song increments on endSession, owner-scoped reset service.
The prior 'missing reset button' report was a requirement misread; statistics display reset-on-account-change is implemented without adding destructive UI.
src/constants/api.ts and src/services/api.ts still hardcode production host/key (known debt, not a newly introduced regression in this retest).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (harness scope); native installed/uninstalled cold/warm not runnable in this environment

seed_data_creation: None (read-only API calls and isolated JS test doubles only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per user instruction, no Expo preview/Metro debugging was performed. Live API tests now target the app-configured origin directly (https://api.themegaradio.com) with public header parity. Physical native deep-link acceptance (installed/uninstalled, cold/warm) remains environment-blocked and must be validated on devices.
rca_of_issue: Iteration_51 traversal failure was due to URL normalization before malformed-segment rejection. Current implementation validates raw path segments prior to normalized routing and now passes targeted traversal/encoding regressions.
